largest recipients of U.S. foreign assistance

manual.how: Open https://foreignassistance.gov/data (Data Download), download the CSV (By Country, By DAC Sector, By USG Sector, By Managing Agency, By Funding Agency), and upload it with ingest.

cache.why: Files are refreshed with the site (data last updated date shown on every page).

redistribution.why: U.S. government data; the site states an Open Data License.

citation: U.S. Department of State and USAID, ForeignAssistance.gov, {dataset}, retrieved {retrieved_long}.
clarify: Which transaction type? Obligations (commitments), Disbursements (money spent), Appropriated and Planned, or President's Budget Requests: never add them together. Default: obligations for 'how much aid', disbursements for 'how much was spent'.
Current or constant dollars? current_amount is nominal; constant_amount is inflation-adjusted. Default: current for one year, constant for trends.
Which years? Fiscal years (October-September); the latest year is incomplete until reporting closes.
